meta.title: Evergreen Office: ten use case universe
conventions: Business days are weekdays; no holiday calendar.
A statement is due 10 business days after its period end (statement_due); late = business days after the due date.

The administrator NAV of a portfolio is the sum of its investment holdings at the values the administrator had at 06:00 UTC on the 2nd business day after the month end; cash is held at entity level and reported in the cash file, not inside the portfolio NAV (this keeps the seed's EG-GROWTH NAV of 16,400,000 = A 10,000,000 + B 6,400,000).
Known now = the latest statement for the period received by the cutoff, whatever its status; the Fund A amended statement counts as known only once the demo drops it.
Quarterly funds carry their last statement forward in the months between; any value older than 90 days at the as-of date is Stale (C and D at 9 Oct 2026).
The liquid book instrument 'Evergreen Liquid Book' is the sum of the 20 securities; quantity x price = value on every line.
Bond prices are per 1.00 nominal (4 dp); the convertible is quoted per unit; equities per share.
FX forward mark-to-market = buy_amount / spot - sell_amount (forward points ignored).
Index and FX daily levels: linear interpolation between month-end anchors over business days, 2 dp (indices) or 4 dp (FX); no noise.

index_levels.daily_rule: level(d) = anchor_prev + (anchor_next - anchor_prev) * business_days(prev, d) / business_days(prev, next), rounded to 2 dp; weekdays only

fx_fixings.daily_rule: same linear rule as the indices, 4 dp; 9 Oct carries the 8 Oct fixing

versions.calculation_method: Weighted sum of monthly index returns; the private-markets sleeve is the equity index return plus 300 bps a year (25 bps a month). FX by the signed fx_fixing rule.
Re-weighting proposed by Sofia Reyes on 1 Oct 2026; component sheet still being filled in.

rules.definition_text: Cash may differ by up to 5,000 USD per entity per day before it needs a case.
The CIO sees a change over 100,000 USD or 0.5% of a fund.
A manager estimate may be used in the investment report only.
A manager statement is due within 10 business days of the period end.
Convert with the WMR 4pm USD/SGD fixing in the market data file.
A confirmed capital call due within 30 days opens a Finance case to fund it.
EG-LIQUID: Harborview Semiconductor must be between 0% and 5% of the portfolio.
EG-LIQUID: asset_class 'listed_equity' between 60% and 90% of the portfolio.
EG-B-OPS: manager 'Cedarpoint Ventures' between 0% and 55% of the portfolio.
EG-FUNDS: asset_class 'hedge_fund' between 20% and 60% of the portfolio.

process.project_title: Monthly investment report in USD and SGD

steps.name: Collect the exports
steps.control: Row count and file totals agree with the control totals of the file.
steps.exception: A rejected file is re-requested the same day.

steps.name: Check cash against the administrator
steps.control: Difference per entity per day within the cash tolerance of 5,000 USD.
steps.exception: Over tolerance opens a break case (Entity B, 12,400 USD on 8 Oct 2026).

steps.name: Collect manager statements
steps.control: Every expected statement received within 10 business days of the period end.
steps.exception: Late or missing: follow-up draft to the manager.

steps.name: Convert to SGD
steps.control: Converted at the WMR 4pm USD/SGD fixing of the period end.

steps.name: Review and approve the report
steps.control: Maker never checker; a manager estimate is used in the investment report only.
steps.exception: A revision over the CIO materiality threshold (100,000 USD or 0.5% of a fund) reopens the review.

steps.name: Read the report
steps.exception: Questions to managers logged as open questions.
